Scenario fixture: resize-text-content-loss (WCAG 1.4.4)

Each target has a stable id of the form rtcl_case_NN: the box that clips the text, which a finding names. The rule applies only to a page laid out at a viewport 640 CSS pixels wide or less, as a 1280 pixel window shows it at 200% zoom, so load this page at that width (the browser test does). It needs a layout, so in jsdom it reports nothing: each case's data-outcome-resize-text-content-loss attribute gives that jsdom verdict, and the browser test checks the one in the title. A page with no text in a box that can clip it (notApplicable) and a page at a wider viewport need pages of their own, and are covered by the browser test.

A. Text that fits its box

01 — PASS: a box 80 pixels high with overflow hidden, two lines
Opening hours today, nine to five.
02 — PASS: a short label on one line that doesn't wrap
Opening hours

B. Text the box cuts off (asked, leaning fail where it is certainly cut)

03 — CANTTELL: a box 40 pixels high with overflow hidden hides lines (leans fail)
Opening hours today, and the rest of the week from nine in the morning to five in the afternoon, except on public holidays.
04 — CANTTELL: a line that doesn't wrap, cut at the right edge (leans fail)
Opening hours today, and the rest of the week from nine to five.
05 — CANTTELL: a clip-path: inset() hides the lower lines (leans fail)
Opening hours today, and the rest of the week from nine in the morning to five in the afternoon.
06 — CANTTELL: the second line is cut by a few pixels only (no lean)
Opening hours today, nine in the morning to five.
13 — CANTTELL: a box 20 pixels high shows its first line; the line after a break drops out wholly (leans fail)
Opening hours
Monday to Friday, nine to five

C. Text the box shortens (asked, leaning fail)

07 — CANTTELL: text-overflow: ellipsis (leans fail)
Opening hours today, and the rest of the week from nine to five.
08 — CANTTELL: -webkit-line-clamp: 2 (leans fail)
Opening hours today, and the rest of the week from nine in the morning to five in the afternoon, except on public holidays.

D. Text no box cuts off (not judged)

09 — NEUTRAL: a box 40 pixels high that scrolls (overflow: auto)
Opening hours today, and the rest of the week from nine in the morning to five in the afternoon, except on public holidays.

Opening hours for screen reader users
